official_name: Employees' State Insurance Scheme, under the Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948
responsible_ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
description: Statutory, self-financing social security and health insurance scheme covering employees of notified factories/establishments earning within a wage ceiling, funded by employer-employee contributions.

applicable_states.note: Minimum-establishment-size threshold for coverage varies by state (10 in most States/UTs; reported as 20 in some - unverified).

target_population: Employees earning up to Rs 21,000/month (Rs 25,000/month if disabled) at covered factories/establishments with 10+ employees (varies by state), and their dependents.
eligibility_factors_not_applicable: age (general beneficiary age not gated; recruitment-specific age limits are a different, unrelated context)
